newsitem.title: GERMANY: East German chemical workers demand equal pay.
newsitem.headline: East German chemical workers demand equal pay.

text.p: Several thousand workers in the east German chemical sector on Wednesday held protests in Leipzig to demand that their wages be increased to the same level as that of their western German counterparts.

Hubertus Schmoldt, chairman of the IG Chemie trade union, told workers that no offer had been made by employers in the current wage round to lift east German chemical wages above their current level of 82 percent of western salaries.
Unions and employer groups agreed in 1990 after unification that east German wages in the sector should be brought up to western levels in the long-term.
Schmoldt called on employers to make an offer improving east German wages in the next round of wage talks scheduled for next Tuesday.
